analysis: The supplied PR change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md is documentation only. The visible patch excerpt (hunk around base line 524, head lines 524-544) documents a new `--prefill-fixed-prompt` flag for the scheduler-prefill benchmark mode and a seed-token rotation (`iteration * 17`) for measured iterations. The three supplied units are BASE text from line 848 onward, which is unchanged context. They contain the status/doctor/models/update/beta/fan/login/unenroll/report sections, the paths table, the provider.toml keys table, env passthrough and runtime constants. I examined them against the threat model and found no security regression. The docs describe no new network endpoint, authorization path, key handling or data exposure. The unchanged context states security-relevant behaviors consistent with the threat model: owner-only 0600 state files, the App Attest worker flag forwarded only when exactly `1`, the prefix cache kill switch DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE (T-041), update hash verification, and logout and unenroll semantics. Limits on this review: the patch excerpt is truncated (patch_excerpt_complete=false), and the head-side lines 527-544 were not supplied as text. The benchmark flag is a diagnostic-only CLI option in a separate source file (BenchmarkCommand.swift) that was not supplied. Whether the code actually matches the doc is not verifiable here, and the diagnostic runs with prefix caches off per the docs. Any code change implementing the flag lives outside this batch. A reviewer of those files should confirm the benchmark path does not touch coordinator, attestation or cache storage, though nothing here suggests it does.
